```yaml
name: SDK CI & Release

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    tags:
      - '*'
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate-tag:
    name: Validate tag matches pyproject.toml version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Get version from pyproject.toml
        id: get_version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(python -c "import tomllib, sys; print(tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml'))['tool']['hatch']['version'])")
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Compare tag to version
        run: |
          TAG=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}
          if [ "$TAG" != "${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}" ]; then
            echo "❌ Tag $TAG does not match version ${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ Tag matches version."
          fi

  sdk-ci:
    name: SDK Generation CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Generate SDK
        run: uv run hatch run server:sdk-generate

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm i -g pnpm

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Typecheck
        run: pnpm run typecheck

  publish-python:
    name: Publish Python package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'release' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Publish to PyPI
        env:
          HATCH_BUILD_PYPI_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PYPI_TOKEN }}
        run: uv run hatch publish

  publish-typescript:
    name: Publish TypeScript SDK
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'release' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Generate SDK
        run: uv run hatch run server:sdk-generate

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm i -g pnpm

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Typecheck
        run: pnpm run typecheck

      - name: Configure npm auth
        run: echo "//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}" > .npmrc

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: pnpm publish --access public --no-git-checks
```
